readonly: You can look but not change anything here. Ask the owner for edit access.
db_unavailable: The page's data store is not available in this view. Sign in, or ask the owner to share the page with you.
db_slow: Some data has not loaded yet. What you see may be out of date.
write_failed: Could not save ({code}). Try again in a moment.
saved: Saved. Claude applies it at the next sync.
paused_banner: Everything is paused. Daily runs, replies checks and posting are stopped until you resume.
setup_wait_title: Waiting for Claude to publish the configuration
setup_wait_body: In Claude Code, run /publish-status once. The setup forms fill in from your workspace files.
step_brand_lede: Who is speaking, and how the role is disclosed in every first message.
step_categories_lede: What you sell or recruit for. Channels, conversations and funnel destinations all refer to these.
step_funnel_lede: Where a qualified person is invited, one destination per category.
step_languages_lede: Languages used in the groups. A language is used live only after someone fluent has reviewed it.
step_knowledge_lede: Short statements the writer may use. Nothing else counts as a fact.
step_channels_lede: Paste the URLs of the Facebook groups and fanpages you want to seed.
step_caps_lede: How much the system may do per day. Start careful.
step_schedule_lede: When the daily runs happen, on the owner's computer clock.
h_owner_email: Reply alerts and reports go here.
f_ui_language: Language of this page and the approval sheet
h_disclosure: Used in the first message of every conversation. Use {rep} and {brand}.
h_audience_tz: Where the people in the groups live. Posting times follow this.
h_operator_tz: Your computer's clock. Run times below use this.
h_categories_funnel: A new category gets an empty funnel destination. Fill it in on the Funnel destinations step.
h_tracked: A redirect that counts clicks per channel. Use {channel} where the channel id goes.
h_member_counts: Enter the member count of each destination every week. Joins are the change between counts.
h_languages: Use codes like en, vi or es-419. Until a language is reviewed, Claude only drafts in it and marks the drafts.
h_lang_used: A channel still uses this language.
h_facts: Tick Approved only for statements you stand behind. Unapproved facts are drafts that are not used in live posts.
h_facts_empty: Add what you can say about your company and each category. Claude never invents prices, stock or delivery times.
h_paste: One per line. Groups look like facebook.com/groups/…, fanpages like facebook.com/yourpage.
added_n: {n} channel(s) added. Save to keep them.
h_join_yourself: You join the groups yourself. Claude never joins or signs in for you.
preset_careful_d: Recommended for the first two weeks.
preset_normal_d: A bit more activity once health has stayed green.
preset_custom: The limits were edited by hand in the workspace. Picking a preset replaces them.
cap_identity_personal_max_offer_posts_pe: Offer posts per day, personal profile
cap_content_max_link_share: Share of items that may contain a link
h_caps: Safety rules and Facebook pacing stay in force whatever you choose here.
page_identity: Also allow writing as the brand Page where a channel permits it
h_schedule: Times are on your computer's clock ({tz}). The schedule applies once Claude sets up the recurring jobs.
v_tz: {f} must be a timezone name like Europe/Madrid.
v_email: The owner email does not look like an email address.
v_cat_id: Category id "{id}" must be lowercase letters, digits, - or _, and cannot be both/unknown.
v_one_category: At least one category is required.
v_https: The destination URL for "{id}" must start with https://.
v_dest_prefix: The {type} URL for "{id}" must start with {prefix}.
v_fb_url: Channel {id}: the URL must be a facebook.com group or page.
v_group_url: Channel {id}: a group URL contains /groups/. Set the kind to Fanpage for a page.
v_joined: Channel {id}: add the date you joined, because it is active or cooling down.
v_lang_declared: Channel {id}: language {lang} is not on the Languages step.
v_fit: Channel {id}: pick at least one category from the catalog.
v_one_language: At least one language is required.
v_lang_code: "{l}" is not a language code like en, vi or es-419.
channels_lede: State and rules of every group and fanpage. Claude reads these before any run.
no_channels_body: Paste group or fanpage URLs below, then join them yourself and set the state to active.
no_queue_body: After the next daily run, the proposed items appear here with a preview.
say_in_chat: When you are done, tell Claude in chat:
marks_are_proposals: Marks here are proposals. Nothing is posted until you confirm in chat, and edited items are shown to you again first.
edit_note_ph: New text, or what to change
leads_note: Only people who engaged with us, and a contact they gave us themselves. Never shared outside this page.
running_help: Scheduled runs and approved posts go ahead as usual.
paused_help: Scheduled runs, replies checks and posting are stopped. Nothing is lost; resume when ready.
run_now: Ask Claude to run something now
run_now_help: This leaves a request. Claude shows it to you in chat and runs it only after you say yes.
requested: Request saved. Claude will ask you in chat.
pause_channels_help: A paused channel is skipped by scans and posting.
notes_help: Preferences and questions. A note never makes Claude post, join or message anyone on its own, and it cannot change the safety rules.
note_ph: For example: prefer shorter replies in the Springfield board.
